en.t: Winter had ended, spring had returned, and the calendar began a new year.

units.source_text: 朱雀院中忙着准备三公主入六条院的种种事宜。

en.t: At Suzaku's palace, everyone was busy making all the arrangements for the Third Princess to enter the Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 以前恋慕三公主的人，都失望悲叹。

en.t: Those who had formerly loved and longed for the Third Princess were all disappointed and lamented bitterly.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝也爱这三公主，希望她入后宫，现在知道已经如此定局，也就断了念头。

en.t: Emperor Reizei also loved this Third Princess and had hoped she would enter his palace, but now that he knew the matter was settled this way, he gave up the thought.
Let us set this matter aside for the moment.

units.source_text: 且说源氏今年正好四十岁。

en.t: Now, Genji happened to be exactly forty years old this year.

units.source_text: 祝寿之事，朝廷也很重视，认为此乃国家大典之一，已经在纷纷着手准备。

en.t: The court also attached great importance to the celebration of his birthday, regarding it as one of the great ceremonies of state, and preparations were already under way everywhere.

units.source_text: 但源氏一向不喜欢铺张，故一概辞谢。

en.t: But Genji had never liked extravagance, so he declined everything.
